narrative: You have made your first money decision. Your bike goal is 100 Spark Coins. What will you do next?

choices.description: Create a savings goal and track your progress toward the bike.
Use your current Spark Coins on something you want now.

outcomes.description: You created a savings goal. Planning makes it easier to see how close you are to your target.
You chose an immediate reward. You can still continue working toward your bike goal.
